bullets.content: [general] After every solve, read top-5 hotspots (nearest face, local h, share) and view error before choosing the next mesh; place refinement before raising DOFs. Compare runs by where elements go, not just how many. Don't misread iso error as uniform.

[general] After every solve call view(kind=error,view=iso) and list the 5 hotspots (coords, share, group, local h) in reasoning. Spend the last solve on the largest-share hotspot with local h >1.3x requested size. Use all 4 solves.
[general] Before each solve(), confirm the last mesh() call's node count equals the intended mesh (a past run solved the wrong mesh, expected 5159 nodes).

[general] Change ONE factor per solve. When trimming an over-budget assigned mesh, change one size per free mesh() call, lowest-error region first; solve a within-budget version before stacking more coarsening.
[general] Refinement that changes local h by <20% is noise. After each mesh call, check the target group's touching h dropped >=30% before solving.

[general] Plan 4 solves: (1) explorer mesh + error view; (2) one-factor change at top hotspot; (3) finer reference (sizes x0.8) for compare; (4) best candidate. compare every candidate against solve 3 before submitting.
[general] Use one solve for a cheaper-DOF experiment: score divides by DOFs, so ~1.5x automesher DOFs with similar error beats 2.1x.
[general] Write the first message answering every feedback item line by line before any tool call; omission is flagged as a broken promise.

[general] REPEATED: finest mesh submitted twice (23.8k, 21.9k). Never invent an error for the finest solve; take e >= compare diff to the next mesh (6.7-9%). Compute A/c per solve: A=(g/2)^2 if g<2 else g/2, g=0.3192/e. Submit the max; 11.4k DOFs scored 0.231 vs 0.191 at 23.8k.
[general] Choose the submitted solve by accuracy times cost per solve, using compare diff; energy differences <1% are noise. Never submit by DOFs alone.
[general] Never spend a solve reproducing a recipe whose result is known (a9's g1 mesh, 8.36% field). Spend it on a new mesh or a finer reference.
[general] Diversity bonus needs base >=90% of best (missed 0.218 vs 0.2196). For a unique frame compute e²N against the best peer and keep it <=~1.11x.

[general] 3D order-2 energy error falls only ~N^-2/3; halving error by uniform refinement costs ~2.8x DOFs. Beyond ~2x automesher DOFs only local refinement at named hotspots pays. +36% DOFs moved error only a few %.
[general] Box radius 0.012 on a ~35 mm part grades nearly everything to box size. Use radius 0.005-0.006 at h 0.012-0.015 (quality 0.15-0.20 in peers' runs). Raise to 0.008 only if min_quality <0.12.
[general] Keep your box-only frame distinct from peers (no f2/edge groups, different h) for the diversity bonus; it pays only if base >=90% of best, so reach ~18-20k DOFs at <=18% field error.
[general] Net force on a near-closed pressurised bore (f23) and curved face (f16) nearly cancels, so small mesh-dependent reaction residuals are normal. Do not spend solves chasing it.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Why r0.007: wide junction box cut saddle cells (|x| 0.006,|y| 0.013,z 0.0255) to 10.7% vs a14's 13.2% at h 0.0047; a wider radius may give ~0.004 there without bigger boxes (estimate).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Pay line: accept a variant only if energy rises >=0.075 x node increase % over 0.03345 J at 6684 nodes (+6% nodes needs >=0.03360 J). Meshing is deterministic; a14 needs no re-solve.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Second radii solve: body box radius 0.008->0.005 only (flank r0.004). Saves DOFs graded into shafts f3/f16. Accept if energy loss % <=0.075 x DOF saving %; if both pay, combine in solve 3.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction boxes must span x 0.009-0.024 (and mirror), |y|<=0.017, z 0.019-0.036. A narrower box [0.015..0.024,|y|<=0.01] left z 0.0255 corner cells (±0.0174,±0.0129) at h 0.005 holding 12.3% error, saddle hotspots at x~0.013 at h 0.0053.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring (z 0.056,|x| 0.006,|y| 0.013) held 17.6% with 0.0036 clamp box (f2 h 0.00489); f2 0.0025 r0.005 + edge40 0.0025 r0.004 gave 14.4% at f2 h 0.00396. Use group+edge pair, not a thin box >=0.0033.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Thin clamp box at 0.0028 cut clamp-ring cells to 11.6% (f2-group peers 14.5-15.4%) but put ~900 elements on f21 (h 0.0033). Use 0.003, z from 0.053 to save nodes; 0.0025 r0.005 only if budget allows (cells still 2.8-3.1% each).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Hard node cap ~6100-6500 (<=6700): 6560 nodes (19.7k DOFs) gave cost term 0.308; 7068 gave 0.273. At ~18k DOFs same error score ~0.34. If over, coarsen clamp or lower box by 0.0003-0.0005, never the mid wall box.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Never pair mid wall >0.0054 with lower box >=0.006 (repeated twice): lower wall z 0.005-0.015 near f20/f23 is contested, P3 read +19% at lower 0.006. Keep one body box <=0.0054 down to z 0.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction refinement must stay <=0.0033 requested: 0.0037 lost 0.8% energy for -7% DOFs (fails pay line). Rim hotspots f16/f19 still at 0.0041-0.0047; never coarsen this band.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a14 (base 0.244, field 17.8%, 20.1k DOFs): edge40 0.0025 r0.004 added to f2 0.0025 gained 0.46% energy for +4.6% DOFs, the only clamp add-on passing the pay line.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Never leave a z-gap between boxes at h>=0.012: junction box zmax 0.038 and clamp box zmin 0.047 left z 0.036 cells at h 0.0055 with 2-2.6% each. Overlap boxes by >=2 mm.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Point refinements are inert here: 8 points 0.0028 r0.005 inside a 0.005 box added ~94 nodes, left rim h ~0.0059 and hotspots #1-#6 at 15-27% error. Never use points; enclose hotspot clusters with a box ±3 mm, radius >=0.004.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] After mesh(), read 'element size near' for f16/f19. A 0.003 flank box gave f19 0.00497 / f16 0.00536. Target <=0.0042; if missed, widen the box in |y| rather than shrinking its size.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a8: h 0.03 with body box gave 5997 nodes vs 6315 at h 0.012. Global h only sizes the boss shafts (zero error); coarse global h with boxes saves ~5% nodes.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction hotspots #3-#5 on f16/f19 z~0.030 stay h 0.0041-0.0047 despite 0.0033 request. Widen flank boxes in |y| to 0.018, z 0.022-0.036 rather than shrinking size; check f16/f19 element size <=0.0040.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] 67% of elements sit in 64 low-error cells at mean h 0.0042. Raise body box to 0.006-0.0065 away from junction, clamp and bosses to cut DOFs below 17k.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring z 0.053-0.0605 holds top four cells (5.3,5.3,4.0,3.1%), hotspots at h 0.0043 on f20. Test 0.0028 r0.004 over z 0.054-0.0605, paid by coarsening lower body to 0.007.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Coarsening all boxes ~7% for -10% nodes gave 0.03296 vs 0.03323 J: neutral. Tweaks <10% waste solves; make structural changes.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Binding term is field error (18.4% vs 10.2% check points). Top error cells: boss/body junction z≈0.0255, x=±0.0174 (4.2-4.7% each), hotspots on f19/f16/f20 at local h ~0.005. Refine there locally, not globally.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a11 (h 0.0045, f2 0.0025 r0.005, edges 39/8 0.003 r0.005): field error 17.5% vs 18.4% at same ~24k DOFs. Tight radii concentrate elements at re-entrant junctions. Copy it; change only the f19 target.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a8: flank boxes [0.009,-0.016,0.019,0.023,0.016,0.033] + mirror at 0.0035 r0.005 added to a3's recipe gave best field error of low-DOF runs (18.1% at 18.9k); leftover error moved to the clamp ring.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Coarse h 0.015 with radius 0.012 boxes: 18k DOFs, 20% field, quality 0.106-0.165; worse than a11 (tight radii). Use h <=0.014 so shaft faces stay <=0.008 (P2 read -14.4% at 0.0064); don't box shafts.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] A local size must be <=0.6x the surrounding box size to register: edge 0.0028 under a 0.0038 box (0.74) gave compare 0.162 = noise.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Assigned: a14 recipe with ONLY tier1 0.0018->0.002 (box [0.015,-0.012,-0.0081,0.029,0.012,-0.0058] r0.003). Clamp layer saturated: 0.0016 bought 0.06% field for +4% DOFs. Expect -3% DOFs for <=+1.5% field. Then test widening 0.003 box in |y| to ~0.03 along f7.
